d:
Bihar MLC Election Counting : bihar men vidhan parishad ki 8 siton par matganna jari hai. Graduate aur shikshak nirvachan kshetron ki siton ke lie ho rahi counting par sabhi ki najren tiki hain. matganna ke sath ummidvaron ki jit-har ki tasvir saph hogi.
Bihar MLC chunav ki counting, sitvar natije, ummidvaron ke pradarshan aur taja rajnitik apdet ke lie hamare sath jure rahen.
